name: Mabel Moss
description: Retired librarian, allotment enthusiast and community administrator. Knows which neighbour borrowed every spade.

name: Tom Reed
description: Early-rising baker at the old mill. My sourdough starter is called Doughreen and has more followers than I do.

name: Aisha Patel
description: Bicycle mechanic in the station shed. Getting Bramblewick rolling again, one suspicious rattle at a time.

name: Ben Rowan
description: Orchard keeper and patient pruner. The trees are easier to organise than the harvest picnic.

name: Clara Finch
description: Potter at Brook Barn. I make sturdy mugs for people who consider tea a food group.

name: Diego Sol
description: Guitar teacher and occasional busker beside the duck pond. The ducks remain a tough audience.

name: Elsie Thorne
description: Smallholder with six sheep, two muddy dogs and an optimistic laundry schedule.

name: Farah Bell
description: Community cook with a fondness for lentils and very large saucepans. Nobody leaves our lunch hungry.

name: Gus Cooper
description: Retired carpenter. Happy to rescue useful furniture, including chairs with strongly held opinions.

name: Hana Brooks
description: Neighbourhood dog walker. I know all the footpaths and most of the dogs' preferred puddles.

name: Ivo Green
description: Market gardener growing salad leaves behind the chapel. Dedicated to compost and unreasonable quantities of courgettes.

name: Jules Hart
description: Sewing enthusiast and keeper of the hall's costume cupboard. Expert at making things fit actual humans.

name: Kofi Lane
description: Patient tech helper based above the post office. Explaining Wi-Fi without telling anyone to be more digital.

name: Lena Birch
description: Flower grower sharing the old walled garden. My bouquets are local; the slugs are unfortunately local too.

name: Mateo Fox
description: Tool sharpener and tinkerer. The shed contains a place for everything, allegedly.

name: Nora Vale
description: Retired teacher running the seed library. Believes a labelled envelope can change the world.

name: Omar Field
description: Cargo-bike enthusiast helping with village errands. The basket has carried everything except a willing cat.

name: Pippa Stone
description: Knitter, spinner and enthusiastic counter of stitches. If I go quiet, I am probably counting.

name: Quinn Lake
description: Local history rambler with a waterproof notebook. Knows why the bridge is called New Bridge despite its age.

name: Rosa Hill
description: Home baker specialising in big trays of small treats. My oven has a better social life than I do.

name: Sam Oak
description: Handy neighbour for small household jobs. Measures twice, then asks where the pencil went.

name: Tessa Moon
description: Yoga teacher offering gentle sessions in the warm village hall. Touching your toes is entirely optional.

name: Umar Brook
description: Preserver of seasonal gluts. If it sits still long enough, I will consider putting it in a jar.

name: Vera Clay
description: Basket maker using local willow. Providing practical storage for the things we swear we will sort later.

name: Will Ash
description: Woodland volunteer and maker of insect hotels. The insects have yet to leave a review.

name: Xenia Park
description: Language tutor who moved here for the quiet and stayed for the village arguments about jam.

name: Yasmin Dale
description: Neighbour offering plant care while you are away. Fluent in thirsty fern and mildly offended orchid.

name: Zach Wren
description: Driver with a small estate car and a soft spot for useful errands. Very strict about wearing seat belts.

name: Ada Fern
description: Artist painting village signs and the occasional surprisingly cooperative chicken.

name: Bramblewick Village Hall
description: A shared space for lunches, repairs, classes and meetings about the next meeting. Managed by community volunteers.
